_doc: X-04 / 16 D20 — the EN source strings. Key convention: loc.<domain>.<id>.<field>, lowercase, dot-separated, snake_case segments (14 §6: loc.chapter.5.name). This file contains only keys that are genuinely referenced by data in this repository today; it is not a stub of strings the game does not yet have. {target} is a runtime parameter, not a translatable literal.
